name: Webhook notes
description: Keeps a tidy note of your webhooks: the events that matter are told at once, the rest go in a short morning digest. The last 50 are kept.
author: The Sara team

settings.label: Events that matter
settings.tip: Event names to tell you about at once, separated by commas, for example deploy.failed, payment. A * at the end matches the start of a name. Everything else waits for the digest.

es.Event names to tell you about at once, s: Nombres de eventos que te avisa al momento, separados por comas, por ejemplo deploy.failed, payment. Un * al final coincide con el comienzo de un nombre. El resto espera al resumen.

fr.Event names to tell you about at once, s: Noms d'événements signalés tout de suite, séparés par des virgules, par exemple deploy.failed, payment. Un * à la fin correspond au début d'un nom. Le reste attend le résumé.

de.Event names to tell you about at once, s: Ereignisnamen, die es dir sofort meldet, durch Kommas getrennt, zum Beispiel deploy.failed, payment. Ein * am Ende passt auf den Anfang eines Namens. Alles andere wartet auf die Übersicht.

pt-BR.Event names to tell you about at once, s: Nomes de eventos avisados na hora, separados por vírgulas, por exemplo deploy.failed, payment. Um * no fim combina com o início de um nome. O resto espera o resumo.

it.Event names to tell you about at once, s: Nomi di eventi da segnalarti subito, separati da virgole, per esempio deploy.failed, payment. Un * alla fine corrisponde all'inizio di un nome. Il resto aspetta il riepilogo.
